towns.name: Al-Arqas
towns.summary: Al-Arqas (31.2S 13.7E, 'The Haven') is an oasis in the trackless A'mun Desert, founded shortly before 10 PY when Gharu'ndim desert-walkers found a hidden spring in the southern dunes; once an arrival point for new Isparians, it is now quiet and sparsely populated. The town lies in a sunken bowl at sea level (z 0) ringed by golden dunes 20-40 m high: at its centre the spring, a dark crystal pool ringed by lit candles, ferns and a palm, with the Life Stone beside it; around it the nullified gromnie statue on its pedestal, the Town Network portal, an octagon tower, a yellow-green dome and flat rooftop-garden houses (House of Treasure, House of Peace, Armaments of Truth, the Tavern at Al-Arqas, where candelabra burn), while a stained-glass church tower and another rooftop-garden house stand on the southern dune crest.
